whatItDoes.text: The company sells beverage concentrates and finished drinks through bottling partners.
whatItDoes.quote: Our concentrate operations typically generate net operating revenues by selling beverage concentrates, sometimes referred to as “beverage bases,” syrups, including fountain syrups, and certain finished beverages to authorized bottling operations

howItMakesMoney.text: It earns revenue by selling concentrates to bottlers.
howItMakesMoney.quote: Our concentrate operations typically generate net operating revenues by selling beverage concentrates, sometimes referred to as “beverage bases,” syrups, including fountain syrups, and certain finished beverages to authorized bottling operations

howItMakesMoney.text: It also earns revenue by selling finished sparkling drinks and other beverages to retailers.
howItMakesMoney.quote: Our finished product operations generate net operating revenues by selling sparkling soft drinks and a variety of other finished beverages to retailers

competitiveEdge.text: The company says its strong, stable bottling and distribution system lets it grow by making and selling new products worldwide.
competitiveEdge.quote: Our strong and stable bottling and distribution system helps us capture growth by manufacturing, distributing and selling existing, enhanced and new innovative products to consumers throughout the world.

competitiveEdge.text: The company says it owns and markets several of the world’s largest non‑alcoholic sparkling soft‑drink brands.
competitiveEdge.quote: We own and market several of the world’s largest nonalcoholic sparkling soft drink brands, including Coca-Cola, Sprite, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, Fanta and Diet Coke/Coca-Cola Light.

marketPosition.text: The company says its branded beverages represent about 2.2 billion of the 65 billion daily beverage servings worldwide.
marketPosition.quote: Beverages bearing trademarks owned by or licensed to the Company account for 2.2 billion of the estimated 65 billion servings of all beverages consumed worldwide every day.

industryTrends.text: The company notes that rapid digital evolution and e‑commerce growth are reshaping consumer shopping habits.
industryTrends.quote: The rapidly evolving digital landscape and growth of e-commerce in many markets has led to dramatic shifts in consumer shopping habits and patterns.

source.label: 10-K filed February 20, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis

industryTrends.text: The company says ongoing concern about obesity and chronic disease is affecting the beverage industry.
industryTrends.quote: There is ongoing concern among consumers, public health professionals and government agencies about the health problems associated with obesity and other chronic diseases

demandDrivers.text: The company says its success depends on connecting with consumers by offering a wide variety of beverage options that meet their desires, needs and lifestyles.
demandDrivers.quote: We believe our success depends on our ability to connect with consumers by providing them with a wide variety of beverage options to meet their desires, needs and lifestyles.

demandDrivers.text: The company says its strong bottling and distribution system helps capture growth by delivering innovative products to consumers worldwide.
demandDrivers.quote: Our strong and stable bottling and distribution system helps us capture growth by manufacturing, distributing and selling existing, enhanced and new innovative products to consumers throughout the world.

biggestRisks.text: Unfavorable economic and geopolitical conditions could hurt financial results.
biggestRisks.quote: Unfavorable general economic and geopolitical conditions could negatively impact our financial results.

biggestRisks.text: The company operates in a highly competitive commercial beverage industry.
biggestRisks.quote: We operate in the highly competitive commercial beverage industry.

biggestRisks.text: Supply‑chain disruptions, including higher commodity, raw‑material and transportation costs, could adversely affect financial condition or results.
biggestRisks.quote: Disruption of our supply chain, including increased commodity, raw material, packaging, energy, transportation and other input costs, may adversely affect our financial condition or results of operations.

outlook.text: Management says it believes the company is well positioned to create value for the company and its stakeholders.
outlook.quote: we believe we are well positioned to create value for our Company and our stakeholders.

source.label: 10-K filed February 20, 2026 · Item 7, Management's Discussion and Analysis
